evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: This PR implements consensus cleanup rules resolving long-standing vulnerabilities such as quadratic sigops CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree collision (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks. While not active on mainnet, bringing a complete, tested implementation upstream provides substantial strategic value for testing and evaluation across the project.
